doc.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Playing with Hank Jones in Billy Eckstine's band
summary: Wess recalls Hank Jones, Gene Ammons and King Kolax in the Eckstine band at the Sudan Club for nine weeks in 1946.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, you know, Hank and I go back a long way. In fact, we were in the Billy Ekstine band together in 1946. Actually, I have a photo of us standing in the bar in the Sudan Club with Hank Jones, Gene Ammons, King Kolax and myself. From 1946, we were in there nine weeks and Hank was the pianist with us. We go back that far, and we affiliate, off and on, in different situations with Thad or whatever, you know? We know each other.
